photos.author: Livelikerw
photos.view: Northeast main entrance at Hankou/Jiangxi Middle corner, before the recent renewal.
features: A concave stone corner above a projecting sheltered porch; grouped columns support the porch, with a small curved balcony/column niche above.
Rusticated corner piers, large projecting dentilled cornice and upper semicircular windows; different design from the southeast and northwest corners.
Lower entrances, multi-pane windows and street-facing columns are partly masked by traffic, trees and wires.
limits: No complete roof or interior/whole courtyard plan.
Air conditioners, signs and service wires record 2013 conditions rather than required current geometry.

dimension_policy.identity: 上海公共租界工部局历史主楼 / 工部局大楼 / 老市府大楼; historical north and east wings plus part of the southern wing, with the preserved northwest corner and short west return.

address_policy.secondary_article: 江西中路215号、209号及汉口路193号
address_policy.resolution: Retain the inventory field and disclose differing entrances/door-number accounts; exact historic-current correspondence not independently established.

date_policy.gazetteer: 1913年开始；1924年（一说1922年）竣工；另一段称1915年开工。
date_policy.architect_project_page: Original completion 1922; contemporary project competition2015, project start2016, construction2019, completion2024, opening2025.
date_policy.resolution: Keep source/event distinctions; do not silently publish1919 as a proved single completion year.

dimension_policy.material_and_structure: Gazetteer: reinforced-concrete foundation/frame and brick wall faced in granite, imported steel windows; classical/Baroque decorative treatment.
dimension_policy.historic_designer_and_builder: Gazetteer names 工务处建筑师特纳 and 华商裕昌泰营造厂; modern designer is David Chipperfield Architects. Initials differ across secondary/designer wording and are not normalized into a new full identity.
dimension_policy.area_policy: Gazetteer4832m² footprint and22705.6m² gross floor area are historical source values; renewed project67000m² or4.2万m²above/2.6万m²below are complex-wide scope, not historic-wing footprint scaling targets.

height_policy.documented_levels: Official gazetteer: original three storeys, partly four; later generally raised to four.
height_policy.cancelled_tower_policy: 50 m belongs to a proposed tower explicitly cancelled after settlement, never to an existing building-height input.

drawing_scale_estimate.method: Visual reading of the published section plus grayscale pixel checks of its graphic scale and principal horizontal lines; not a measured/surveyed elevation.
limits: Parapet/guard line identity, exact grade and drawing stage have uncertainty.
A typical section does not prove every corner height, facade variation or roof detail.
The new pavilion and courtyard hall must not be reclassified as the historic principal roof.

height_policy.model_policy: Use declared author dimensions with approximate drawing-scale support; preserve the absence of a textual measured metre height. Historical upper walls are broadly around 19–20 m in the section, local corner/parapet treatments may differ; no uniform historical 23–25 m height is proved by the new roof pavilion.

dimension_policy.renewal_scope: New west/southwest perimeter completion, set-back roof pavilion, independent red villa, new events hall and underground works are separate interventions/components. The historical-wing model does not certify the entire 外滩·老市府 project.
dimension_policy.original_completion_fraction_conflict: DCA says three quarters originally complete;2024Chinanews quotes two thirds. Both describe an incomplete perimeter; neither fraction determines the historic mask or seam coordinates.
dimension_policy.seam_policy: Design-office pre-renewal high view, published plan and current northwest seam photograph corroborate qualitative historic extent. Old OSM location/width differences are not a construction-demolition map. Final source split and conservative unresolved strips remain an explicitly estimated mapping decision.
dimension_policy.courtyard_policy: Keep courtyard and both detached buildings separate. A project diagram and current photos strongly support their independent identities but exact OSM-to-object assignment/post-move location is reviewed separately.

permissions_and_use.public_outputs: Original geometry/materials and source facts/links/metadata/hashes; no photograph textures, source image copies or drawing payloads.
